answer: Reputation Decay on Idle Identity: each identity's trust score decays toward zero, and any action between near-identical identities (measured by behavioral echo similarity) applies a penalty to both scores. Genuine agents refresh trust by producing costly, verifiable work; clones instead accumulate mutual penalties. Each added sybil must fund fresh cipher work to rebuild decayed trust, paying verification compute and latency per identity while old clones fall below the usability threshold by dawn of each epoch.
